Class CodeEditor

java.lang.Object
org.patternfly.component.BaseComponent<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>
org.patternfly.extension.codeeditor.CodeEditor
All Implemented Interfaces:
ElementAttributeMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, ElementClassListMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, ElementConsumerMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, ElementContainerMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, ElementEventMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, ElementIdMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, ElementQueryMethods<HTMLElement>, HTMLElementAttributeMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, HTMLElementDataMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, HTMLElementStyleMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, HTMLElementVisibilityMethods<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, IsElement<HTMLElement>, TypedBuilder<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, Component, OuiaSupport<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>, Modifiers.Readonly2<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>
public class CodeEditor extends BaseComponent<HTMLElement, CodeEditor> implements Modifiers.Readonly2<HTMLElement, CodeEditor>
A code editor is a versatile text editor that allows for editing various languages. Backed by CodeMirror 6 via the @patternfly-java/codeeditor NPM package.

Syntax highlighting

The syntax colors are ported from the PatternFly React code editor and use the PatternFly palette tokens (shade 50 in light mode, shade 30 in dark mode). Each color can be overridden with a CSS custom property --pfj-code-editor--<name>--color:

Syntax color custom properties
NameApplies toDefault
keywordkeywords, booleans, null, this, primitive typespurple
stringstrings, charactersgreen
commentcomments (rendered in italics)gray
numbernumbers, literals, constants, escapes, URLsorange
variablevariables, function namesblue
builtinpredefined variables, labels, anchorsteal
typetype and class namesyellow
tagHTML/XML tag namesred
attributeHTML/XML attribute namesred
attribute-valueHTML/XML attribute valuesblue
propertyJSON keys, CSS properties, object membersred
keyYAML keys, object literal keysorange
regexpregular expressionsred
metaannotations, decoratorspurple
delimiterangle brackets, processing instructions, doctypegray
headingMarkdown headings (rendered bold)purple
insertedinserted lines (diffs)green
deleteddeleted lines (diffs)red
changedchanged lines (diffs)orange
invalidinvalid syntaxred

Example: 

pfj-code-editor {
    --pfj-code-editor--keyword--color: var(--pf-t--color--blue--50);
    --pfj-code-editor--comment--color: light-dark(#6a737d, #8b949e);
}
